terra.problem: The bike comparison is a modern scenario about kids, which the audience rule excludes.
The joke says the nations dropped the lion into the pit. The text says he was trapped in it, not how he entered it.
The explanation says the nations do not run from the lion and that he does not drive anyone out. The text does not say either of those things.
Saying he goes after the fortified places first adds a sequence the text does not give.
The text says the lion was brought to the king of Babylon, not that he was taken to Babylon or made a long trip.
The text does not say Babylon was where he ended up in captivity. It says he was brought to the king of Babylon.
The text names the king of Babylon, but does not say the lion was taken into captivity in Babylon.
The text says the east wind dried the fruit; it does not say the fruit was never taken.
The text does not say nobody came to gather or pick up the fruit.
The explanation repeats that the wall is not mentioned without adding an observation or sounding like Papa Dorin.
